subject: Request: short quote + permission to use pilot metrics in a 2-line case snippet
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morgan <anna@teralogix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short quote + permission to use pilot metrics in a 2-line case snippet

Hi Anna —

Congrats again on wrapping the pilot this week. Quick recap from our side: during the four-week POC we saw a 38% reduction in average response latency and a 27% drop in per-token inference cost when using the recommended batching + KV cache config. I attached the one-page metrics summary (redwood_pilot_metrics_TeraLogix_Q3.pdf) you can share internally.

We’re putting together a short customer snippet (2–3 lines) to highlight the outcome for a brief case highlight on our site and across a one-page success summary. Would you be open to:

- A 1–2 sentence public quote from someone on your team (we can draft and you can edit), and
- Permission to reference the metrics above and the TeraLogix logo?

If it helps, I can send a 2-line draft for you to approve. Also happy to jump on a quick 15-min call to align on wording. Proposed times: Tue 12/8 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 12/9 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks so much — we really appreciate how quickly your team moved.

Best,
Olga
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the summary and for sending the metrics. The team is pleased with the latency and cost improvements; the dashboard numbers match what we saw. You have our permission to reference those high-level metrics (latency reduction and per-token cost decrease) in marketing materials.

A quick draft quote from me: “Redwood helped us cut inference latency and drive meaningful cost savings during a short pilot — the results let us ship a much more responsive feature to customers.” Please feel free to shorten.

We’re also fine with the TeraLogix logo being used for the snippet, pending a short look from our marketing lead. Carlos will loop in legal/marketing if they want to tweak wording.

I can do Wed 12/9 at 14:00 PT for a 15-min call.

—Anna
VP Product, TeraLogix
